evidence.decision: Selects short post-action alternatives versus an explicitly requested menu or critical alert, and separates cancellation from destructive commitment.
evidence.artifact: Requires handlers or an action-to-outcome table naming trigger, choices and retained-work behavior.
evidence.transformation: Canceled voice-note example replaces immediate deletion and Yes/No ambiguity with Save Recording, destructive Discard Recording and safe keep-editing cancellation.
evidence.verification: Checks every choice, system/outside dismissal, large text and repeat invocation; fails cancellation that commits or destroys data.
evidence.applicability: Preserves visionOS nonapplicability and watch mandatory Cancel/four-total-button maximum, with native input claims withheld.
evidence.handoffs: Routes urgent confirmation to alerts, command reveal to menus and surrounding exit consistency to modality.
evidence.distinctiveness: Intentional action trigger, related alternatives, destructive roles and cancellation outcomes define an action-sheet-specific decision process.
